Gumshoos

Normal

Alola · Generation 7

Gumshoos is a Normal-type Stakeout Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 14.2 kg. It evolves from Yungoos. Its highest base stat is Attack (110), with a base stat total of 418.
